items.title: 구찌의 본질을 자신만의 언어로 재정의한 뎀나, '더 스토어 쇼(The Store Show)'
items.summary: GQ Korea covers Demna's SS27 Gucci show staged inside a full-scale mock retail store in Milan, reading the collection through archetypes like 'the rebellious aristocrat' and 'the eccentric' that reinterpret horsebit, bamboo, GG Marmont and Ophidia codes. Analytical, largely admiring tone with no Korea-market consumer commentary.

items.title: 뎀나가 구찌의 엔진에 시동을 걸었다
items.summary: Profile piece tracing Demna's rapid rise from Vetements to Balenciaga to Gucci, framing his 'instinctive and emotional' design philosophy against a backdrop of steep declines: Gucci sales fell 21% in 2024 and a further 25% in H1 2025. Also revisits past Balenciaga child-imagery controversy and his public apology, alongside new sizing-system and in-house atelier initiatives.

items.title: 누구나 원하는 모습으로 살아가는 법, 구찌 2027 봄/여름 컬렉션
items.summary: Collection review of Gucci SS27 describing Demna's synthesis of 'La Famiglia' theming, 1990s Gucci references, February's body-conscious silhouettes and May's Times Square 'GucciCore' moment into one cohesive personal statement, delivered inside a store-set at Milan Fashion Week.

items.title: デムナの「グッチ」ランウエイデビュー ルネサンスに遡って人間の姿を写実的に描くトム・フォードを思わせるセクシー路線
items.summary: WWD Japan's trade review of the SS27 show frames it as evoking Tom Ford-era realism and Renaissance body depiction, describing a sexy, tailored direction distinct from Demna's earlier conceptual Balenciaga work.

items.title: グッチ 2026年春夏コレクション - 「家族」をテーマに、デムナが手掛ける初のコレクション
items.summary: Japanese fashion trade outlet recaps the show staging: four large spaces built as Gucci retail sets, menswear opening barefoot-in-loafers Italian styling followed by womenswear drawing on the brand's 1921 equestrian/luggage-shop origins.

items.title: 2025年Gucci涨价了吗？已反转：2026年9月最高降40%
items.summary: Chinese financial media reports Gucci's official permanent price cuts across mainland China of 30-40% on bestsellers: Ophidia mini bucket bag from RMB12,300 to RMB8,700, GG Marmont small bucket bag to RMB8,100, Mercato small tote from RMB25,500 to RMB20,000. Kering's CEO reportedly acknowledged some items were 'priced too high'; move tied to a 9% H1 2026 revenue decline (down 10% in Asia-Pacific) and framed as breaking luxury's 'only rises, never falls' pricing norm, with speculation other houses like YSL/Burberry could follow while Hermes keeps raising prices.

items.title: Gucci秋季大秀如何复刻门店打造沉浸式体验？
items.summary: Report on how the Milan show recreated an immersive store experience, noting attendees Ni Ni (brand ambassador), Song Weilong, Wen Qi, Tian Xiwei among Chinese celebrity guests, plus international names Billkin and PP.

items.title: 网友对Gucci新系列为何从观望转为改观？
items.summary: Weibo discussion thread on why netizen sentiment shifted from wait-and-see skepticism to approval after the store-set show: cited reasons include the format blurring runway/retail lines, restrained logo use and refined tailoring replacing prior maximalism, and celebrity turnout (Ni Ni, Song Weilong, Donatella Versace). No visible like/repost counts on the fetched thread.

items.title: Gucci暴跌40%破"只涨不跌"铁律！现在入手还是继续观望？
items.summary: Weibo consumer-advice thread debating whether to buy now or wait further, framing the up-to-40% price cut as breaking the long-standing luxury 'only goes up' pricing rule; reflects mixed consumer sentiment between bargain-seeking and skepticism about resale/value retention.

items.title: 오늘 가격 인상... 명품 리셀업자 반응
items.summary: Korean secondhand-luxury reseller's Threads post reacting to a round of luxury price increases (jewelry vs. bags/wallets/shoes/apparel), commenting that hard-goods category hikes are driving away buyers ('안 사야겠다') while noting secondhand condition/pricing dynamics; illustrates reseller-side skepticism toward category-wide price moves affecting Gucci alongside peers.

items.title: 명품 갤러리 - 구찌 정품 확인/구매 문의 스레드 활동
items.summary: Korean luxury-goods community board (DCInside) showing ongoing everyday threads about authenticating and buying Gucci items (wallets, bags), reflecting routine consumer-forum engagement rather than campaign-driven buzz; volume is steady chatter rather than a spike tied to the show or price news.

items.title: 패션계의 이단아 뎀나 영입한 구찌, 어떻게 바뀌었을까
items.summary: Korean business daily assesses how Gucci has changed one year into Demna's tenure, weighing his 'enfant terrible' reputation from Balenciaga against early stabilization signs in Gucci's sales decline, in context of Kering's broader earnings struggles.

items.title: Gucci Spring 2027 Ready-to-Wear Runway, Fashion Show & Collection Review
items.summary: T1 trade review of the SS27 show, noting Demna's own show notes framing Gucci as 'luxury that wants to be seen' and 'the tension between propriety and sensuality,' with tailored aristocratic looks alongside rugby shirts, tartan and oversized belts; used here as an English-language cross-check on the Milan show since it directly concerns Gucci's global positioning relevant to NEA markets watching the brand's turnaround.

items.title: 提供一些关于Gucci涨价的新闻报道
items.summary: Weibo aggregation thread citing that Gucci also raised prices 3-7% on select classic bags/sneakers (GG Marmont, Ace) in China this year -- shown alongside the separate discount news, illustrating confused/mixed consumer perception of whether Gucci is raising or cutting prices depending on category and timing.
